summary: Comprehensive testing of Event Store feature (4th webstore type). Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: All key flows verified. Found and fixed 1 critical bug causing 500 error on event store creation.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: 500 error when locked_settings fields were empty strings. Pydantic Optional[float] fields reject empty strings. Frontend handleCreateStore was not sanitizing empty strings to null before POSTing to backend.
integration_issues.fix_applied: frontend/src/pages/Webstores.js handleCreateStore: added empty-string-to-null conversion for locked_settings before createWebstore() call (same logic as handleSaveLockedSettings already had)

design_issues.screen: Event Store - Create Dialog & Settings Tab
issues: Date input fields (Event Start Date, Event End Date, Order Deadline, Pickup/Delivery Date) use native browser date picker (HTML5 <input type='date'>) instead of shadcn Calendar component. This is visually inconsistent with the date picker used in other parts of the app.

design_issues.screen: Admin-Controlled Financial Settings in Create Dialog
issues: Admin-Controlled Financial Settings (locked_settings) section appears for ALL store types in the create dialog, not just event stores. This may be intentional (tenant controls finances for all store types), but should be verified with product owner.

action_items: Optional: Verify if Admin-Controlled Financial Settings should show for all store types or only event stores in the create dialog
Optional: Consider adding backend-side validator to LockedSettings model to coerce empty strings to None (defensive backend fix to complement frontend fix)
Optional: Consistent date picker: Replace native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar component for Event date fields if design consistency is required
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: handleCreateStore in Webstores.js didn't sanitize locked_settings empty strings to null before POST. This caused 500 (Pydantic validation error) when creating any store type (not just event). Fix: convert '' to null for all locked_settings numeric fields before API call.

Code quality: locked_settings sanitization logic is duplicated - handleSaveLockedSettings and the new fix in handleCreateStore have the same pattern. Consider extracting to a shared utility function cleanLockedSettings().
Security: WEBSTORE_PUBLIC_FIELDS correctly excludes locked_settings and all event-specific fields. sanitize_webstore_for_public() is a whitelist-only approach - safe.
_normalize_webstore_doc correctly includes 'event' in the valid type set, preventing coercion to 'business'. Verified by both backend test and code review.
store_slug is auto-generated with _generate_unique_slug() using async DB uniqueness check. Correctly uses slug counter suffix for duplicates.

The update webstore endpoint uses input.model_dump() with v is not None filter - this means locked_settings cannot be unset once set (setting to empty dict would be ignored). This is intentional for locked fields.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all key flows verified, 1 bug found and fixed)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST event store 'Gala Test 2026 UI' via UI (pending cleanup). Backend tests create/delete TEST_ prefixed event store automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Event Store (4th webstore type) fully implemented and tested. Key test data-testids: event-name-input, event-type-select, event-start-date-input, event-order-deadline-input, event-location-input, auto-close-switch, allow-late-orders-switch (in create dialog); edit-event-name-input, edit-event-location-input, edit-order-deadline-input, edit-auto-close-switch, save-event-settings-btn (in settings tab); edit-locked-{field}-input, save-locked-settings-btn, edit-sh-enabled-switch (locked settings). Known issue: creating any store type with empty locked_settings was causing 500 error - FIXED in this iteration by sanitizing empty strings to null in handleCreateStore.

rca_of_bug.bug: 500 Internal Server Error when creating Event Store (or any store) without filling locked_settings fields
rca_of_bug.root_cause: Frontend formData.locked_settings initializes numeric fields as empty string ('') not null. handleCreateStore sent these empty strings directly to backend. Backend LockedSettings Pydantic model has Optional[float] fields - Pydantic v2 rejects empty string for float type, causing ValidationError → 500.
rca_of_bug.reproduction: 1. Open Create Webstore dialog. 2. Select any store type. 3. Leave locked_settings fields empty. 4. Click Create Store. → 500 error.
rca_of_bug.fix: In handleCreateStore (Webstores.js), before calling createWebstore(), convert all empty string values in locked_settings to null: `const cleanedLockedSettings = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(formData.locked_settings || {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, v === '' ? null : v]))`
